tasks.gr12-dna-protein-synthesis-t1: Topic: DNA and Protein Synthesis. Cover DNA structure, genes and chromosomes, semi-conservative replication, RNA, transcription, translation and the genetic code. Ask Grade 12 learners to interpret molecular-biology diagrams, trace the flow of information from DNA to proteins and explain how base sequences determine amino-acid sequences.
tasks.gr12-meiosis-t1: Topic: Meiosis. Cover meiosis I and meiosis II, homologous chromosomes, crossing over, reduction division, independent assortment, gamete formation and non-disjunction. Ask Grade 12 learners to identify stages from diagrams, compare meiosis with mitosis and explain how meiosis contributes to sexual reproduction and genetic variation.
tasks.gr12-reproduction-vertebrates-t1: Topic: Reproduction in Vertebrates. Cover external and internal fertilisation, ovipary, ovovivipary, vivipary, reproductive adaptations in fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals, and parental care. Ask Grade 12 learners to compare strategies, explain how environments influence reproduction and identify adaptive advantages of different reproductive methods.
tasks.gr12-human-reproduction-t1: Topic: Human Reproduction. Cover the structure and functions of the male and female reproductive systems, puberty, the menstrual cycle, ovulation, fertilisation, implantation, gestation, the placenta and foetal development. Ask Grade 12 learners to sequence human reproductive processes, interpret hormone changes and explain the roles of key structures.
